svg.text: Backend-heavy campaign and user operations platform.
Auth, users, campaigns, imports, validation, unsubscribe, webhooks, admin tooling and production operations.
Explicit boundary. Explicit state. Explicit failure.
Admin stays behind auth; providers prove requests; readiness means dependencies are actually ready.
Campaign operations, user management and admin surfaces.

g.text: public flow without exposing admin state
privileged actions never share public routes
process liveness separated from dependency readiness
sensitive fields and query parameters stay out of logs

svg.text: The platform is mostly backend and operational tooling.

g.text: Helmet · rate limit · redaction · CI secret scan

svg.text: Request handling keeps public, authenticated and provider boundaries explicit.
Failure modes are named and guarded instead of hidden.

g.text: query params and structured secrets removed
alive process does not imply ready

svg.text: A request earns trust one boundary at a time.
The point is explicit operational truth.

g.text: each surface proves who it is
bad inputs and sensitive logs are contained
